# Gateway API conformance fixtures

Converted to JSON (only the kinds the controller reads, `{GATEWAY_CLASS_NAME}`
replaced by `rws`) from the Gateway API conformance suite at tag `v1.6.3`:
`conformance/base/manifests.yaml` (`base.json`) and
`conformance/tests/<name>.yaml` (`<name>.json`), from
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api.
